newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PRI Automation Inc.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PRI Automation Inc.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Gus Richard cut his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for PRI Automation Inc to $2.32 a share from $2.40 following PRI's Q4 earnings report.
-- Richard maintains a buy rating on the stock with a 12-month price target of $50.
-- PRI earned $0.49 a share for its fiscal fourth quarter ended September 30 versus a consensus estimate of $0.50 a share. In the year ago quarter, PRI earned $0.35 a share.
-- In a statement, Richard said the shortfall was due to the company's difficulty managing rapid growth rather than a lack of product demand.
-- Shares were trading at 33-3/4, off 4-3/4, in late morning exchange trade.
